title: Invisibility Revamp
description: This mod adds two new items The Sharded Carrot and Arrow of Blindness. So you can sneak up on ur enemies and blind them for a surprise attack!
body:
This mod revamps invisibility by adding two new items: **Sharded Carrot** and **Arrows of Blindness** So you can sneak up on your enemies and take them with a surprise attack!

### Sharded Carrot:
#### Effects:
- Invisibility 1m
- Slowness 10s
- Blindness 10s
#### Recipe:

![Recipe For Sharded Carrot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4d3bf56936098fc47c1cd648aa82932635cde99.png)

### Arrow of Blindness:
#### Effects:
- Blindness 5s
  
#### Recipe:
